firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player and the seating order at random.
clarifications: Standard Setup assigns factions in any way, then randomizes the starting player and seating order. Advanced Setup also seats players and picks the first player randomly.
Factions set up in setup order (A, B, C, and so on), which is separate from turn order.
After a player ends Evening, the next clockwise player begins their turn.
